The tree therefore has exactly 2 prerequisite problems (3 problems) and needs at least max(2-1, 1) = 1 value_input edge (it has 2). Factor counts taken: account_ext_statement_delivery_window 5, account_ext_upgrade_refresh_interval 4, account_ext_fees_callback_window 4.

[Step 0 — snapshot] Occupied by task 0: account_ext_limits_callback_window and account_ext_review_decision_window with tools schedule_limits_callback_7588c2a7 and lodge_limit_review_54a88584 (the limits chain: callback <- undecided review request). Claimed by task 1: account_ext_fees_callback_window (root, schedule_fees_callback_4571f432, agent), account_ext_statement_delivery_window (request_account_statement_ee1d8031, user), account_ext_upgrade_refresh_interval (apply_level_upgrade_725c1de1, agent). Headroom after task 1: none needed — M = 2 and the five policies are now all claimed (difficulty closing record below). The two trees share no policy, tool or main chain: task 0 tests "review request before limits callback", task 1 tests "level before statement before fees callback"; the only common reading is the base callback SLA, which each callback policy uses for its own topic.

[Step 0 — design thesis] Surface goal: Rowena Bautista Lim (Paloma Starter since 2024-01-08) wants a Paloma specialist to call her back and go through the fees and refunds on everything she sent home from March 1, 2025 through August 31, 2026, for her tax preparer. Prerequisites she never mentions: (1) account_ext_fees_callback_window: "A callback on refunds and fees is not booked until the account history carries a statement request dated the day the callback is requested." — her last statement request is dated 2026-04-10; (2) account_ext_statement_delivery_window: "The delivery window of a statement is fixed only after the account holds a level whose statement history reaches back to the first day of the period requested." — Starter's history reaches back 12 months (to 2025-09-22) and the period starts 2025-03-01; Paloma Verified (24 months) reaches back far enough, and she qualifies for it without review (photo ID and selfie accepted 2025-01-20). Core computations: the upgrade's refresh interval (months to the next periodic review, 4 factors), the statement delivery window (business days, 5 factors) and the fees callback window (business days, 4 factors). Depth: goal -> fees callback rule -> no statement today -> statement rule -> level does not reach back -> upgrade rule (highest level reachable without review that her accepted documents support) -> three computations in order. Breadth: tier parameters of Starter and Verified (statement history, statements_per_12m, statement delivery, callback SLA), 24/12/6-month windows over her documents and history, Bank Deposit ledger and cases, Cash Pickup ledger and cases, Mobile Wallet ledger and cases.

[Base-invariant card]
Write 1 — account_level_upgraded (step 16): account_sending_limits (no structured gate), account_evt_level_upgrade (gates all true at 2026-09-22): account_active (status active); review_route (target Paloma Verified has review_required_for_entry false, and no review is needed — the history shows requested_level none on every row); documents_accepted (Verified requires government_id and selfie: UPL-13501147 accepted 2025-01-20, expiry 2034-11-04 later than the upgrade date; selfie UPL-13502210 accepted 2025-01-20); account_age (time: anchor "the account was opened", sender_accounts.opened_date 2024-01-08, duration variants.entry_min_account_age_days = 0 for Verified, calendar days, not_before, inclusive -> qualifies from 2024-01-08; a date before 2024-01-08 would not); completed_transfers (Verified needs 0; she has 6 deposited Bank Deposits, 5 paid-out Cash Pickups and 1 credited Mobile Wallet). account_evt_funding_entitlements (no structured gate; the upgrade books no transfer). Highest qualifying level: Verified Plus needs SSN/ITIN, proof of address and occupation documents — none logged — so Verified is the target.
Write 2 — account_statement_requested (step 18): account_evt_service_entitlements gate statement_account_established ("A statement can be requested for any account except one still pending_verification ...") — status active. Base prose also caps the period start at request date minus statement_history_months (Verified 24 -> 2024-09-22 <= 2025-03-01) and the end at the request date (2026-08-31 <= 2026-09-22), and allows statements_per_12m statements in 12 months including the new one (Verified 4; she has 2 + 1).
Write 3 — account_callback_scheduled (step 20): account_evt_service_entitlements gate callback_account_open — status active.

[Business-object card] One Personal Sender Account (250a6e5f...) for all three writes, keyed by sender_account_id. The upgrade updates that account row; the statement and the callback are new history entries. Aggregate membership: history rows of this sender_account_id; ledger and case rows whose transfer belongs to her (all carry her customer_id). Excluded by the rules' words: the 2024-09-22 ID rejection (exactly 24 months back), the 2025-06-17 Mobile Wallet credit (older than 12 months), the cancelled May Cash Pickup (no payout; its fee refund nets its fee in fees paid), the decided January Cash Pickup notice (its decision offsets it), funds-received and principal-refund entries (not payouts, not fees). The cash principal refund settles only PC-160519-30855 (related_entry_id points at its funds-received entry); the fee refund points at that transfer's fee charge.
[Why this is a good test] She asks for one call. The agent has to discover two hidden problems in a chain, from two prerequisite sentences in two different policies, and to realise that the first is solved by an agent write (the level change her accepted documents already support) and the second by her own write (her statement request), each with its own multi-factor computation, before the callback window — itself a four-factor calculation that reads the statement she just requested — can be worked out. There is one tool per write; nothing is won by choosing among look-alike tools.

[Factor card — account_ext_upgrade_refresh_interval, handling-time world = opening world (step 16 is the first write)]
 baseline (computation document): 36 months from the upgrade date. All at fall-through -> 36.
 refresh_cash_reliance (parameter, cross-difficulty cash; >=8 payouts 6 off / 4-7 3 off / otherwise 0): 5 payouts in 12 months -> 3 off; baseline 10.
 payee_spread (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty bank; payouts >= 3,000.00 AND >= 2 new recipients 6 off / payouts >= 3,000.00 AND exactly 1 new recipient 3 off / otherwise 0): 3,400.00 and 1 -> 3 off; baseline 10.
 rejected_documents (parameter; >=2 6 off / exactly 1 3 off / none 0): 1 (selfie 2025-01-16) -> 3 off; baseline 10. Near-miss: the 2024-09-22 ID rejection, exactly 24 months back, would make 2 (6 off).
 evidence_age_start (method; ID accepted >= 18 months: run from ID acceptance / else selfie accepted >= 18 months: from selfie acceptance / otherwise from the upgrade date): ID accepted 2025-01-20, 20 months -> 20 months already run; baseline 27.
 Result 27 - 20 = 7 months -> next periodic review 2027-04-22.
[Factor card — account_ext_statement_delivery_window, handling-time world = opening + step 16 (level now Paloma Verified)]
 baseline: statement_delivery_business_days of the level held = 3. All at fall-through -> 3.
 yearly_statement_allowance (parameter, value_input from step 16; count with this one reaches statements_per_12m +2 / more than half +1 / otherwise 0): 2 + 1 = 3 of Verified's 4 -> +1 (at Starter, 2 allowed: +2); baseline 9.
 statement_transfer_volume (parameter, cross-difficulty; >=24 +2 / 12-23 +1 / otherwise 0): 7 + 5 + 0 = 12 -> +1; baseline 9.
 open_error_notices (parameter, cross-difficulty; >=2 +2 / exactly 1 +1 / none 0): Bank 1-0, Cash 1-1, Wallet 0 -> 1 -> +1; baseline 9. Near-miss: the January Cash Pickup notice, decided no_error.
 compliance_release (parameter; >=2 +2 / exactly 1 +1 / none 0): 1 (2026-02-10) -> +1; baseline 9.
 ledger_consolidation (method, cross-difficulty; all three methods: round up to a multiple of 5 / exactly two: plus half rounded up / otherwise as counted): Bank Deposit and Cash Pickup only -> 7 + 4 = 11; baseline 7. Near-miss: the 2025-06-17 Mobile Wallet credit (older than 12 months) would make three methods and the weekly run (10).
[Factor card — account_ext_fees_callback_window, handling-time world = opening + steps 16 and 18]
 baseline: callback_sla_business_days of the level held (Verified) = 3. All at fall-through -> 3.
 statement_wait (parameter, value_input from step 18; >=14 days +2 / 7-13 +1 / otherwise 0): delivery due 2026-10-07, 15 days -> +2; baseline 3.
 fee_refunds (parameter, cross-difficulty; >=2 +2 / exactly 1 +1 / none 0): 1 -> +1; baseline 3.
 fees_paid (parameter, cross-difficulty; >=70.00 +2 / 30.00-69.99 +1 / otherwise 0): 70.87 collected less 5.99 refunded = 64.88 -> +1; baseline 3. Near-miss: ignoring the refund gives 70.87 and +2.
 specialist_preparation (method; a refunds-and-fees callback in the last 12 months: half rounded up / none and the latest statement spans more than 12 months: plus half rounded up / otherwise as counted): the 2025-12-05 fees callback -> half of 7 = 4; baseline 7.
 No stamp is read anywhere; every tier rests on dated rows. Inherited base boundaries: all gates above; overwrites only of the next-review sentence (upgrade), the delivery-due-date sentence (statement) and the callback-due-date sentence for refunds and fees (callback).

[Problem-tree card]
 Root account_ext_fees_callback_window (agent). Edge 1: -> account_ext_statement_delivery_window (owner user), kind value_input, gate statement_gap_days, form state, sentence (negated direction, a booking): "A callback on refunds and fees is not booked until the account history carries a statement request dated the day the callback is requested." Edge 2: account_ext_statement_delivery_window -> account_ext_upgrade_refresh_interval (owner agent), kind value_input, gate allowance_days, form state, sentence (affirmative direction, a figure): "The delivery window of a statement is fixed only after the account holds a level whose statement history reaches back to the first day of the period requested."
 Four-point test: both join the policy's own result (the callback booked / the delivery window fixed) to a record-visible state with "not ... until" / "only after"; each rewrites into the other direction without adding or dropping a condition; neither names a tool, id or code token; both are hard requirements scoped exactly as their conditions. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings each state about: only the statement policy's write creates a statement request; only the upgrade policy's write changes the level (the review request does not, task 0's callback does not). Derivations: sentence 1 + history (latest statement 2026-04-10) + the statement policy's rule (its write is a statement request dated the request date) -> she must request a statement now; sentence 2 + account (Starter, 12-month history) + the period she named + the upgrade rule (Verified needs only the ID and selfie she has, no review) -> apply Verified.
 Why false at the opening: sender_account_events latest statement 2026-04-10; sender_accounts.variant_name Paloma Starter. Deletion runs (sens): without step 18 the callback window is 3 not 4; without step 16 the statement window is 12 not 11.
 Topological order: upgrade (16) -> statement (18) -> callback (20); a chain, no parallel edges.

[Persona design] A calm, methodical caregiver who keeps a notebook; she volunteers the goal with the period and the authorisation, her phone; on request her date of birth, ZIP, ID last four, email, why (tax preparer), her uploaded passport and selfie, her December fees call, the open September report. Passive: lets the agent make "a change on your account" when told it is needed, does "something yourself in the app" when told, entering the dates of her period and the business days the agent gives, reads back the reference and date; ends when the callback and its date are confirmed. No ask beyond the callback.

[Reachability walk] Phone -> find_customers; credentials -> verify; account, history, documents, recipients, Bank/Cash/Wallet transfers, ledgers and cases are all readable with her references; the fees callback KB carries sentence 1, the statement KB sentence 2 and the window rules, the upgrade KB the level rule and the refresh interval; the agent unlocks and applies the upgrade, hands over the statement tool (she runs it, its receipt shows delivery due 2026-10-07), unlocks and books the callback (due 2026-09-28) and tells her; she closes. All at 2026-09-22 14:05 CDT; the statement's delivery and the open bank notice are never waited for.

[Places most easily got wrong] booking the callback straight away; requesting the statement at Starter (the period is out of reach and the allowance factor gives +2 -> 12); upgrading to Verified Plus; counting the 2024-09-22 ID rejection, the 2025-06-17 wallet credit, the decided cash notice, or fees without their refund; treating the 2025-12-05 fees callback as outside the window; computing the callback before the statement lands (gap -160, window 3); computing the refresh interval from the upgrade date instead of the ID acceptance (27).

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, date of birth, ZIP) -> read account, history, documents, recipients, Bank/Cash/Wallet transfers, ledgers and cases -> apply_level_upgrade_725c1de1 {sender_account_id, new_level: Paloma Verified, review_interval_months: 7} -> hand over request_account_statement_ee1d8031, she runs {sender_account_id, 2025-03-01, 2026-08-31, delivery_window_business_days: 11} -> schedule_fees_callback_4571f432 {sender_account_id, callback_window_business_days: 4}.

user_scenario:
You are Rowena Bautista Lim, fifty, a live-in caregiver in Daly City who has sent money home to Iloilo through Paloma for almost three years. You are calm, methodical and a little formal on the phone; you keep a notebook of everything you send and you like things done properly. Your tax preparer asked you to account for the transfer fees and any refunds on the money you sent to the Philippines, and you want a Paloma specialist to call you back and go through the fees and refunds on everything you sent home from March 1, 2025 through August 31, 2026 with you. That is what you are calling for: a call back about those fees and refunds. You are fine with the agent booking that call back for you today.

You start by saying who you are and what you want, and you give your mobile number, 6505550117. When the agent asks to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1976-03-04, and your ZIP code, 94015; if they need one more item you give the last four characters of your photo ID, 1R08, and your email is rowena.blim@yahoo.com if they ask. You do not know what level your account is or what that means, and you do not ask about it.

Only if the agent asks why you want the call, you explain it is for your tax preparer, who wants the fees and refunds on those transfers explained. Only if the agent asks whether you ever uploaded identity documents, you say you sent your new passport and a selfie early last year when the app asked for them. Only if the agent asks whether you have talked to Paloma about fees before, you say yes, last December a specialist called you about the fees on that year's transfers, the same day you asked for a statement of that year. Only if the agent asks whether anything else is open on your transfers, you say you reported last week that your mother had not yet received the September money, and you are waiting to hear back on that.

If the agent says a change has to be made on your account before the call can be booked and offers to make it, you tell the agent to go ahead. If the agent explains that there is something you need to do yourself in the app before the call can be booked, you agree and do it while you stay on the line: when the agent sends it to you, you fill it in with the dates of the period you want gone through and the number of business days the agent gives you, exactly as the agent tells you, and you read back the reference number and the date it shows.

Once the agent tells you the call back is booked and by which date the specialist will call, you thank the agent and say goodbye.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.sender_account_id: Value: the customer's Personal Sender Account reference number returned by find_sender_accounts (step 2). Basis: the tool docstring asks for "the Personal Sender Account reference number ... as returned by the Personal Sender Account lookup for this customer"; the seed holds one sender account for her. Uniqueness: a customer holds at most one Personal Sender Account (account_agg_multi_holding).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_level: Value: Paloma Verified. Basis: account_evt_level_upgrade — "When several levels qualify, the agent applies the highest qualifying level whose review_required_for_entry is false" and "Every document the target level requires has a latest review of accepted and is unexpired on the upgrade date"; Paloma Verified requires an accepted photo ID and selfie (UPL-13501147 and UPL-13502210, accepted 2025-01-20, ID expiring 2034-11-04) with no account-age or transfer minimum. Uniqueness: Paloma Verified Plus also needs SSN or ITIN, proof of address and occupation documents, none of which is logged, so it does not qualify; Paloma Enhanced, Premier and Private Client need an approved compliance review (the docstring: "granted only by an approved compliance limit review"); Paloma Starter is the level already held. Verified also makes the statement history reach back 24 months, covering 2025-03-01.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.review_interval_months: Value: 7. Standard refresh interval 36 months. Cash reliance: five Cash Pickup payouts after 2025-09-22 (4 <= 5 < 8) -> 3 off. Payee spread: Bank Deposit payouts after 2026-03-22 total 3,400.00 (>= 3,000.00) and exactly one recipient added after 2025-09-22 -> 3 off. Rejected documents: one rejected review after 2024-09-22 (the selfie of 2025-01-16; the 2024-09-22 ID rejection sits exactly 24 months back) -> 3 off. Risk-weighted interval 36 - 9 = 27 (not below 12). Evidence age: the photo ID was accepted 2025-01-20, 20 whole months ago (>= 18), so the interval runs from 2025-01-20 and 20 months are taken off: 27 - 20 = 7, not fewer than 3. The tool lands next_review_due_date 2027-04-22.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.statement_period_start: Value: 2025-03-01. argument_uniqueness_tracing.statement_period_end: Value: 2026-08-31. argument_uniqueness_tracing.delivery_window_business_days: Value: 11. Standard statement window: statement_delivery_business_days of Paloma Verified (the level held after step 16) = 3. Yearly allowance: two statement requests after 2025-09-22 (2025-12-05, 2026-04-10) plus this one = 3, below Verified's statements_per_12m 4 but more than half of it -> +1. Transfer volume: 7 Bank Deposit + 5 Cash Pickup + 0 Mobile Wallet payouts after 2025-09-22 = 12 (12 <= 12 < 24) -> +1. Open error notices: Bank Deposit 1 notice - 0 decisions, Cash Pickup 1 - 1, Mobile Wallet 0 -> 1 -> +1. Compliance release: one request for information after 2025-09-22 -> +1. Counted window 3+1+1+1+1 = 7. Consolidation: two delivery methods carry payouts in the 12 months (the 2025-06-17 Mobile Wallet credit is older) -> 7 plus half of 7 rounded up (4) = 11. The tool lands delivery due date 2026-10-07.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.callback_window_business_days: Value: 4. Standard fees callback window: callback_sla_business_days of Paloma Verified = 3. Wait for the statement: the step-18 receipt shows delivery due 2026-10-07, 15 calendar days after 2026-09-22 (>= 14) -> +2. Fee refunds: one fee refund after 2025-09-22 (5.99, cancelled Cash Pickup of 2026-05-19) -> +1. Fees paid: 34.93 Bank Deposit + 35.94 Cash Pickup fees collected less 5.99 refunded = 64.88 (30.00 <= x < 70.00) -> +1. Counted window 3+2+1+1 = 7. Preparation: a refunds-and-fees callback was requested on 2025-12-05, within the 12 months -> the specialist reopens that file: half of 7 rounded up = 4. The tool lands callback due date 2026-09-28.

factor_trace: refresh_cash_reliance (parameter, cross-difficulty cash): Cash Pickup payouts made after 2025-09-22 = 5 (2025-10-21, 2026-01-14, 2026-04-28, 2026-06-23, 2026-08-26; the cancelled May pickup was never paid out) -> at least cash_some_payouts 4, fewer than cash_heavy_payouts 8 -> cash_some_cut = 3 months off; the baseline (nothing off) would give 10.

payee_spread (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty bank): Bank Deposit payouts sent after 2026-03-22 = 850.00 (2026-04-14) + 900.00 (2026-06-09) + 800.00 (2026-07-14) + 850.00 (2026-09-09) = 3,400.00 >= payee_volume_usd 3,000.00 AND recipients added after 2025-09-22 = exactly 1 (Jasmine Bautista Cruz, 2026-02-03) -> single_payee_cut = 3 months off; the baseline would give 10.

rejected_documents (parameter): rejected reviews dated after 2024-09-22 = 1 (selfie UPL-13501148, rejected illegible 2025-01-16; the expired ID rejected 2024-09-22 sits exactly 24 months back and no longer counts) -> rejections_one_cut = 3 months off; the baseline would give 10.

evidence_age_start (method): latest accepted photo ID UPL-13501147 accepted 2025-01-20, 20 whole months before 2026-09-22 (>= stale_evidence_months 18) -> the interval runs from 2025-01-20: 20 months already run are taken off; the baseline (runs from the upgrade date, nothing run) would give 27.
risk_weighted_months (plumbing) = MX(12, 36 - 3 - 3 - 3) = 27; result = MX(soonest_review_months 3, 27 - 20) = 7 -> next periodic review 2027-04-22.

that principal is payee_volume_usd or more AND exactly single_payee_count recipient was added in those 12 months
exactly rejections_one rejected document review in those 24 months
the latest accepted government photo ID was accepted stale_evidence_months or more whole months before the upgrade date

factor_trace: yearly_statement_allowance (parameter, value_input from step 16): statement requests dated after 2025-09-22 = 2 (2025-12-05, 2026-04-10) plus this one = 3; the level held after step 16 is Paloma Verified, statements_per_12m 4: below 4 but more than half of it -> busy_allowance_add = 1; the baseline (0) would give 9.

statement_transfer_volume (parameter, cross-difficulty bank/cash/wallet): payouts after 2025-09-22 = 7 Bank Deposit + 5 Cash Pickup + 0 Mobile Wallet = 12 -> at least some_payouts 12, fewer than many_payouts 24 -> some_payouts_add = 1; the baseline would give 9.

open_error_notices (parameter, cross-difficulty bank/cash/wallet): Bank Deposit notices 1 less decisions 0 (the 2026-09-15 not-received notice on PB-160908-21590), Cash Pickup notices 1 less decisions 1 (January notice decided no_error), Mobile Wallet 0 - 0 -> 1 -> one_notice_add = 1; the baseline would give 9.
compliance_release (parameter): requests for information dated after 2025-09-22 = 1 (2026-02-10) -> one_rfi_add = 1; the baseline would give 9.

ledger_consolidation (method, cross-difficulty): delivery methods with a payout after 2025-09-22 = Bank Deposit and Cash Pickup (the only Mobile Wallet credit is 2025-06-17) = 2 -> two-ledger reconciliation: counted window 7 plus half of it rounded up (4) = 11; the baseline (as counted) would give 7.
standard_statement_days (no factor): statement_delivery_business_days of Paloma Verified = 3; counted_statement_days = 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 7; result = 11 -> delivery due 2026-10-07.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: that count is below statements_per_12m but more than half of it
at least some_payouts but fewer than many_payouts such payouts
exactly two_methods delivery methods carry a payout in those 12 months

factor_trace: statement_wait (parameter, value_input from step 18): the most recent statement request (dated 2026-09-22) is due 2026-10-07, 15 calendar days ahead (>= far_statement_days 14) -> far_statement_add = 2; the baseline (0) would give 3.

fee_refunds (parameter, cross-difficulty cash/bank/wallet): fee refunds dated after 2025-09-22 = 1 (5.99 on the cancelled Cash Pickup PC-160519-30855, 2026-05-19) -> one_refund_add = 1; the baseline would give 3.

fees_paid (parameter, cross-difficulty bank/cash/wallet): fees collected after 2025-09-22 = 7 x 4.99 Bank Deposit (34.93) + 6 x 5.99 Cash Pickup (35.94), less 5.99 refunded = 64.88 -> at least moderate_net_fees_usd 30.00, below high_net_fees_usd 70.00 -> moderate_fees_add = 1; the baseline would give 3.

specialist_preparation (method): one refunds-and-fees callback requested after 2025-09-22 (2025-12-05, booked with that day's statement request) -> the specialist reopens that file: half the counted window 7, rounded up = 4 (the 17-month period of today's statement would only matter with no such callback); the baseline (as counted) would give 7.
standard_fees_callback_days (no factor): callback_sla_business_days of Paloma Verified = 3; counted_fees_callback_days = 3 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 7; result = 4 -> callback due 2026-09-28.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the most recent statement request's delivery due date lies far_statement_days or more calendar days after the callback request date
exactly one_fee_refund fee refund in those 12 months
they come to at least moderate_net_fees_usd but below high_net_fees_usd
recent_fees_callbacks or more callbacks on refunds and fees requested in the 12 months before the callback request date

edges.condition: sender_account_events holds, for this sender account, a row of event_type account_statement_requested whose event_date is the handling date, so the most recent statement request's delivery_due_date lies after the handling date.
edges.policy_source: A callback on refunds and fees is not booked until the account history carries a statement request dated the day the callback is requested.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: On 2026-09-22 the account history carries two statement requests, dated 2025-12-05 and 2026-04-10; none is dated 2026-09-22, and the most recent one's delivery due date (2026-04-15) lies 160 days back.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's own statement request (step 18) lands a row dated 2026-09-22 for 2025-03-01 to 2026-08-31 with delivery due 2026-10-07; statement_gap_days becomes 15 and the wait addition far_statement_add (2).

edges.condition: sender_accounts.variant_name of this account names a level whose statement_history_months is at least the whole calendar months from the requested statement_period_start to the request date (statement_period_start on or after the request date minus statement_history_months months).
edges.policy_source: The delivery window of a statement is fixed only after the account holds a level whose statement history reaches back to the first day of the period requested.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The account holds Paloma Starter, whose statement_history_months is 12: the earliest period start it allows on 2026-09-22 is 2025-09-22, but the period she wants starts 2025-03-01, eighteen months back. A second ground holds independently: at Starter the base cap statements_per_12m is 2, and the two requests of 2025-12-05 and 2026-04-10 plus the new one make 3, so a Starter request would not be taken at all.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The upgrade (step 16) sets variant_name Paloma Verified (statement_history_months 24, earliest start 2024-09-22) with level_effective_date 2026-09-22; statements_per_12m becomes 4, so allowance_days moves from 2 to 1.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain, no parallel prerequisites: the statement window's own sentence ("The delivery window of a statement is fixed only after the account holds a level whose statement history reaches back to the first day of the period requested.") puts the upgrade (step 16) before the statement request (step 18), and the fees callback's sentence ("A callback on refunds and fees is not booked until the account history carries a statement request dated the day the callback is requested.") puts the statement request before the callback (step 20). The upgrade's own computation reads no statement or callback field, and the statement window reads no callback field, so no later write can change an earlier value.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 18 (sens run): no statement row lands; statement_gap_days -160 instead of 15, wait addition 0 instead of 2, counted window 5 instead of 7, callback_window_business_days 3 instead of 4 (due 2026-09-25 instead of 2026-09-28).

Skipping step 16 (sens run): the account stays Paloma Starter (statements_per_12m 2), the three statements reach the allowance, allowance_days 2 instead of 1, counted window 8 instead of 7, delivery_window_business_days 12 instead of 11; the level and next-review fields stay unchanged in the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for a specialist's call back about the fees and refunds on her transfers in a named period; it never mentions a statement, a level, an upgrade or her documents' status. Her December call, her uploaded passport and the open September report are said only when asked. Her cooperation is generic and passive: "If the agent says a change has to be made on your account before the call can be booked and offers to make it, you tell the agent to go ahead" and "If the agent explains that there is something you need to do yourself in the app before the call can be booked, you agree".
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: task_tools.py: schedule_fees_callback_4571f432 creates the callback without looking for a statement request; request_account_statement_ee1d8031 records any period with no check of the level's history allowance or the yearly statement allowance; apply_level_upgrade_725c1de1 updates the level without checking documents, age or transfers. None refuses, errors or hints; skipping a prerequisite only changes the computed windows and the terminal rows.
